I re-checked every constraint against the schedule, and I also re-derived it independently to confirm it's the only one.

Dev, Ben, Finn and Ivo are fixed by the adjacency and gap rules: Ben, Finn, Ivo are consecutive, and "one person between Dev and Finn" puts Dev two slots before Finn, so Dev is directly before Ben. Every other constraint then forces Ben into slot 2, which leaves slots 5–9 for Cara, Hana, Elif, Gus and Ann. Of the four possible Cara–Hana pairs in that range, only Cara 7 / Hana 8 leaves a valid placement: Elif 5, Ann 6, Gus 9.

Checking all 16 constraints against the schedule (Dev 1, Ben 2, Finn 3, Ivo 4, Elif 5, Ann 6, Cara 7, Hana 8, Gus 9) gives no violations.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Dev","2":"Ben","3":"Finn","4":"Ivo","5":"Elif","6":"Ann","7":"Cara","8":"Hana","9":"Gus"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
